name: skylark_check_flight_status
intent: Check the status of a SkyLark flight
description: Opens SkyLark Flight status, enters a flight number, searches, and returns the resulting flight status line.
patterns: what's the status of my flight

inputs.name: flight_number
inputs.description: SkyLark flight number to look up

steps.intent: Tap Flight status to open flight status lookup
Enter {{flight_number}} into the Flight number field

outputs.name: flight_status
outputs.example: SL 1190 · ATL → DEN · Sat, Nov 14, 2026 · Delayed 25 min · Gate A7 · Departs 2:45 PM
